### Fixed
- **Vertex AI with a service account key works under Cilium enforcement: Substrate's credential provider reaches `oauth2.googleapis.com:443`** (giantswarm/agent-platform#1042). The provider exchanges an `AnthropicVertexAI` or `GeminiVertexAI` ModelConfig's service account key for an access token itself, at the key's `token_uri`, but `substrate-k8s-credential-provider` allowed only DNS and the apiserver, so every Vertex AI call failed with `could not exchange the service account key for an access token`. The policy now opens `networkPolicy.substrate.credentialProvider.egressFQDNs` on 443/TCP, with the DNS proxy rule that lets Cilium match the names; the default is `oauth2.googleapis.com`, the only `token_uri` kagent admits. A list of its own replaces the default; `[]` leaves the provider the apiserver and DNS only. The kubernetes flavour renders no egress policy and ignores it. `make verify-kagent-netpol` asserts the default, a list of its own and an empty one.
